stories.title: PCA Walk-off + 30-30 Club — Game 1 Recap
stories.angle: PCA hit leadoff HR (1st AB) and walk-off 2-run HR in 10th (his 30th of the season) to lift Cubs over White Sox. First Cub with back-to-back 30-30 seasons; only Sammy Sosa (1993, 1995) has ever done it as a Cub, and never consecutively. Jacob Webb W (5-2). Suzuki also homered. Score omitted per has_score insight.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong opened the game with a leadoff blast.

Then he ended it with a walk-off shot in the 10th — his 30th homer of the year.

That's back-to-back 30-30 seasons. Only Sammy Sosa did it before in Cubs history.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

research.facts:
PCA Walk-off / 30-30 Club — Game 1 Recap
**Facts confirmed (HIGH confidence — 3+ sources):**
- Cubs won Game 1 of Crosstown Classic in 10 innings
- PCA hit the walk-off 2-run HR in the 10th off Hagen Smith — PCA's first career walk-off homer
- PCA's 30th HR of the season (exit velo 98.7 mph, 391 ft to right-field patio)
- PCA also hit the leadoff HR to start the game (5th leadoff HR of 2026 season)
- PCA went 4-for-5 with a walk
- Jacob Webb got the W (5-2); left bases loaded in 10th to set up PCA
- Seiya Suzuki homered for the Cubs
- Randal Grichuk and Andrew Benintendi homered for White Sox
- PCA now has 30 HR + 31 SB in 2026 = second consecutive 30-30 season
- First Cub in franchise history with back-to-back 30-30 seasons
- Only second Cub ever to go 30-30 in a season (Sammy Sosa: 1993, 1995)
- Sosa never did it in consecutive years (1994 was strike-shortened)
**Sources:** ESPN recap, CBS Sports boxscore, MLB.com gameday, AP wire (multiple outlets), CBS Sports article on PCA 30-30, Marquee Sports Network, SI.com
**COMPOUND CLAIM CHECK (Two-Source Rule):**
- "First Cub with back-to-back 30-30" → confirmed by CBS Sports, Marquee Sports, SI.com ✓
- "Sammy Sosa (1993, 1995) only other Cub" → confirmed by CBS Sports ("first since Sammy Sosa") and SI.com ✓
- "Sosa never did it in consecutive years" → confirmed by SI.com (strike-shortened 1994) ✓
**Has_score application:** Game score (7-5) intentionally omitted from tweet per insights finding.

stories.title: PCA Franchise History — First Back-to-Back 30-30 in Cubs History
stories.angle: Only two Cubs in franchise history have ever reached 30-30: PCA and Sammy Sosa (1993, 1995). Sosa never did it in consecutive years (1994 strike-shortened). PCA just did. Stat-backed franchise context.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
PCA just joined a two-person club.

Back-to-back 30-30 seasons. Sammy Sosa (1993, 1995) is the only other Cub who's done it — and even Sosa never went back-to-back.

In one night: leadoff blast, walk-off blast, franchise history.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

research.facts:
PCA Franchise History — Bold Take
**Facts:**
- PCA joins two-person 30-30 club in Cubs franchise history
- Sosa's seasons: 1993 (33 HR, 36 SB per Baseball-Reference) and 1995 (36 HR, 34 SB)
- 1994 strike shortened Sosa's season — 25 HR, 22 SB (did not hit 30 in both categories)
- PCA did it in 2025 (back-to-back 30-30) and now again in 2026
**Note:** The exact HR and SB totals for Sosa's 1993/1995 seasons are referenced from CBS Sports context. I have not independently fetched Baseball-Reference for those exact numbers. Claim is stated broadly ("30-30 in 1993 and 1995") not with precise stats. ← mark as MEDIUM confidence for Sosa specific totals.
